'''Vikki''' is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game. She appears as an antagonist of A Colorful Hunt.

==Debut Appearance==
As an NPC character, Vikki first appears in the Festive Event, A Colorful Hunt.

==History==
In A Colorful Hunt, Vikki briefly appears to order {{c|Cotton}} to go to Grand Gaia to investigate to find and bring back eggs. Despite this order, it is unknown if Cotton continues to serve Vikki upon joining Carrol's group.

==Personality==
A very demanding person, Vikki provides strict orders to her companions, including Cotton, in order to achieve her needs.

==Abilities==
===As a unit===
''See [[Mad Whizz Vikki]] and [[Ebil Genius Vikki]]''

==Notable Relationships==
===Cotton===
Vikki is Cotton's creator. Vikki admits that she rushed her creation and deemed it to not have been her best work. Despite this, Vikki vowed to go through the trouble of finding Cotton, even if it meant "a once-in-a-million chance". Cotton seems to recognize Vikki as her creator and mistress easily upon meeting her.
